The Systems Analyst, under the supervision of the Associate Registrar is responsible for reporting on and coordinating student records and curriculum management system functionalities for the UC Santa Cruz campus. The incumbent applies business process and analysis concepts and department / unit and campus policies and procedures to resolve a variety of business process problems. Works on business process issues of limited to moderate scope where evaluation of processes, procedures and data requires analysis using a variety of factors.

The Business Systems Analyst serves as a liaison from the Office of the Registrar to other academic and administrative departments, including Information Technology Services (ITS).The lead responsibility is development and maintenance of student records, enrollment, curriculum, and degree audit functionality through facilities built into the student information system (Peoplesoft), and related applications such as Coursedog, Curriculum Strategy, and GTeForms. This includes design and annual modification, regular audits, and user testing to preserve the integrity of the system and its data. Related systems duties include analysis and development of new functionality; monitoring and ensuring data integrity, updating security roles, and updating academic structure.

Additional primary responsibilities include ongoing communication and collaboration with advisers and curriculum leads in academic and administrative departments, including: developing ongoing training materials and sessions, process documentation, and policy clarification. Provides systems support for curriculum management, enrollment services, student academic history and academic planning, transcripts, evaluations, archiving, reporting and report writing.

In this role, the incumbent maintains knowledge of industry best practices and works collaboratively with campus entities and other AIS process managers to maximize the effectiveness of student records, advising and degree audit functionality within AIS and associated systems, and to uphold electronic security and the privacy of student records. The Business Systems Analyst upholds UCSC's Principles of Community and the UC Standards of Ethical Conduct. The position currently offers the flexibility to be either partially or fully remote. This position advances to the Senior Systems Analyst with demonstrated competency and skills.
Demonstrated ability to work with others from diverse backgrounds.
Intermediate knowledge of related areas of IT.

Demonstrated oral communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse groups and individuals at all levels within the organization Ability to communicate academic and technical information in a clear and concise manner to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Writing skills sufficient to compose clear, informative and persuasive communications in the form of correspondence, reports, training materials, and documentation. Understanding and skill in documentation standards for business processes and systems requirements.

Self-motivated, Ability to work independently on technical projects as well as on a team of professionals and departmental decision-makers. Able to learn effectively, balance multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
Technical skill to implement detailed test plans and followup applications. Demonstrated ability to monitor systems and troubleshoot applications on an ongoing basis,
